title: SecB Skill Grant Record
description: The GRANTED tier of a skill manifest (ADR-0013). Every field here is written by the promotion service and by nothing else. No package author supplies any of it, and additionalProperties:false means a descriptor field smuggled in here is rejected rather than ignored. Joined to skill-package-descriptor on skill_id + version. This split exists because DEF-A5 found the resolver reading project_scopes, supported_runtimes and max_data_classification straight out of the caller-supplied manifest as its own authorization ceiling. A PUBLISHED grant is conditionally required to carry evidence and approval history; the schema previously accepted PUBLISHED with both empty.

skill_id.description: Charset-constrained so the resolver's reserved-delimiter guard cannot be bypassed by a field that reached the registry through this tier. '@' is the registry's own key delimiter.

status.description: RESTRICTED_PUBLICATION is a required stage of the SECB-SKILL-001 lifecycle that the previous enum omitted, which let FR-SKP-009 be treated as skippable.

max_data_classification.description: An INVOCATION control: the highest data class this skill is certified to operate on. It is NOT a disclosure control. Per SECB-SEC-DECISION-SKILLSHUB-C3-001 (ruled B), skill content carries no independent sensitivity and no content_classification field exists. The call site must stop passing a caller's clearance here as a requested class (DEF-C3).

evidence_refs.description: EXECUTED evaluation results accepted by the Evidence authority. A declared suite in the descriptor is not evidence.

work_package_id.description: REQUIRED. contracts/decision-record.schema.json requires work_package_id on every decision, so a promotion cannot be minted outside an authorized work package (DEF-B3). This was previously asserted in prose while the schema left it optional - a structural claim the structure did not make.

source_content_digest.description: Recorded by the promotion service at promotion, for resolution-time content verification (DEF-B1, DEF-C2). On the GRANTED tier because an author-declared digest verifies nothing.
